questions.question: When Jesus sent out His twelve disciples, He told them to raise the dead. True or false?
When Jesus sent out the twelve disciples, what did He tell them to do if a town refused to welcome them?

answers.text: Shake the dust off their feet
Sing a psalm at the gate

questions.question: Jesus warned His twelve disciples they would be handed over to rulers. Who did He say would speak through them?
Jesus told His twelve disciples they would be hated because of His name. Who did He say would be saved?

answers.text: The one who perseveres to the end
The one who stays out of sight
The one who wins every argument
